exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. intrapartum cesarean delivery)
cohort: 720 dichorionic and monochorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies considered as candidates for trial of labor in 2006, 2010, 2014, and 2018 in Finland
finding: Higher maternal age, primiparity, induction of labor, artificial reproductive technology, fear of childbirth, and non-cephalic/cephalic presentation increased the risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery in twin pregnancies.
